compiled_state.description:
## Observation

Closing abstracted-busy-copperhead (2d87-7428-abcf-4bd9) on 2026-10-28, one external criterion (a Gerrit/CI fact) cost three refused closes and two fresh plan reviews:

1. The completion verifier refused the close. Its top-level remediation (`COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE` in `src/rebar/llm/completion_reconcile.py`) says to "mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment", then re-verify.
2. Adding the tag changed the plan material, so the plan-review close gate refused with `stale-material`.
3. After a fresh review, the close precheck (`txn.ensure_attested_items_valid`) refused again: a tagged item needs an indented `provenance:` continuation line, which the remediation never mentions. Adding that line staled the attestation a second time.

## Mechanism (reproduced in-process on origin/main 5a6c8a19f4f)

- `material_fingerprint` hashes the description after normalizing only checkbox state and insignificant whitespace (`material_diff.canonical_description`). Ticking a box leaves the fingerprint unchanged; adding the tag changes it; adding the provenance line changes it again.
- `COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE` does not say: (a) where the tag goes (the close precheck, the verifier prompt and ADR 0043 recognize it only at the START of the checkbox text, `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`), (b) that a tagged item needs the `provenance:` line, or (c) that the edit is a material plan edit that needs a fresh `rebar review-plan` before the close.

## Prior intent (settles the design)

- f680-4224-6553-48ca (talkable-ungodly-whapuku) classified late-tag staleness as intended anti-tamper behavior: the tag selects which evidence bar completion applies, so it is reviewed plan content. Its resolution taught "classify the criterion before plan review; record evidence in a comment, comments are non-material", and named this remediation string as the composition-incomplete artifact.
- 2f56-313f-6175-41b1 (binary-cobwebby-bittern) evaluated normalizing the tag out of the fingerprint and rejected it: post-certification retagging is the laundering vector the close guards exist for. Its shipped mitigation was to make the close-precheck messages say the edit stales the attestation and needs `rebar review-plan`. The verifier's remediation is the one surface still missing that statement.

So this ticket's original AC "adding or removing `[non-codebase]` leaves the attestation current" contradicts recorded intent and is replaced below. The tag and provenance line stay material. The fix is the remediation text, so following it takes one review cycle instead of two and never surprises the author.

## Approach

1. Rewrite `COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE` to state, for evidence outside the repository: put the tag at the start of the checkbox text (`- [ ] [non-codebase] ...`); add the indented `provenance: environment=<v>; principal=<v>; privilege_posture=<production-equivalent|broader|narrower>; instrument=<live-call|simulation|static-analysis> — <justification>` line under it in the same edit; that edit changes the reviewed plan, so run `rebar review-plan` on the ticket before closing again; and that a criterion already tagged before review only needs the evidence comment, which is non-material. Keep the existing codebase-verifiable path, the untagged-cannot-pass-by-comment sentence, and the snapshot-pinning note. No gate behavior, fingerprint, or verdict changes.
2. Add regression tests that tie the guidance to the contract the close precheck enforces, so the two cannot drift again.

## File impact

- `src/rebar/llm/completion_reconcile.py` — the `COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE` text only.
- `tests/unit/test_non_codebase_remediation_81f2.py` — new regression tests.

## Testing

New tests in `tests/unit/test_non_codebase_remediation_81f2.py`:
- The guidance contains a leading-tag checkbox example that `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` matches.
- The guidance names `provenance:` and every key in `det_measurement_provenance.PROVENANCE_KEYS`, plus every value of `PRIVILEGE_POSTURES` and `INSTRUMENTS`.
- An AC section built by applying the guidance's edit (leading tag plus a filled-in provenance line) has zero `provenance_gaps` and zero `laundering_gaps`.
- The guidance names `rebar review-plan` and says the edit stales the plan-review attestation.
- Fingerprint pins: a tick-only edit keeps `material_fingerprint`; adding the tag changes it; adding the provenance line changes it; any other text edit on the line changes it.
The first, second and fourth tests fail on the current text. Then run `tests/unit/workflow/test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py` and `tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py` (they pin the existing guidance properties), `make lint`, and `make typecheck`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The completion verifier's FAIL remediation tells the author to put `[non-codebase]` at the start of the checkbox text, and its example matches `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`.
- [x] The remediation names the `provenance:` continuation line with all four keys and the allowed `privilege_posture` and `instrument` values, and a description edited as it describes passes `provenance_gaps` and `laundering_gaps` with no findings.
- [x] The remediation states that adding the tag and provenance line is a material plan edit that stales the plan-review attestation and needs `rebar review-plan` before the close.
- [x] Adding the tag, adding the provenance line, or any other text change on the line still changes `material_fingerprint`; a tick-only edit does not.
- [x] The new tests fail before the fix and pass after it; `tests/unit/workflow/test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py` and `tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py` pass; `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0.
